messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Fluoxetine (Prozac) is taken orally, and your doctor will determine the right dose for you based on your condition, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions, do not change your dose or stop taking this medicine without speaking to them first.
Major Depressive Disorder (MDD):
Adults: Treatment typically starts at 20 mg once daily in the morning. Your doctor may increase the dose after several weeks if needed. The maximum dose is 80 mg/day.
Children and adolescents (aged 8 and older): Treatment starts at 10 mg or 20 mg per day. In lower-weight children, the starting dose and target dose may remain at 10 mg/day.
With all patients, the full effect of fluoxetine for depression may take 4 weeks or longer.
Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD):
Adult dose: Treatment starts at 20 mg once daily in the morning and may be increased after several weeks if there is a lack of clinical improvement. The recommended dose range is 20 mg to 60 mg per day. Full therapeutic effect may take 5 weeks or longer.
Triplet: ["fluoxetine", "has dose adjustment based on", "condition"]

The relation 'has dose adjustment based on' in the triplet is defined as 'The dosage of the subject drug may be modified according to the factor specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
B. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
C. 'may have ph adjusted with': The pH of the subject drug may be modified using the substance or chemical specified by the object entity.
D. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
E. 'has product variation': The subject drug has a different formulation or version specified by the object entity.
